title: Developer secures £7.1m exit finance for Bristol scheme
summary:
Mortimer Street Capital has arranged £7.1 million in development exit finance with Recognise Bank for a residential scheme south of Bristol. The facility covers seven completed homes and two plots under construction, enabling the developer to release capital for new acquisitions.

title: Dubai-based agency Strada launches UK property operation
summary:
Strada, a Dubai-based property brokerage founded by British nationals, has announced plans to establish operations in the UK, targeting major cities including London, Manchester, Liverpool, Leeds and York. The agency was founded in 2022 by Gary Allen and Chae Simons, both of whom previously worked for other Dubai-based firms.

title: Industry calls for equal treatment of private and social rents
summary:
The private rented sector should receive equal policy treatment to social housing, according to a property industry executive who observed discussions at the recent Labour Party Conference. The call comes as more than five million tenants rely on private rentals while social housing faces supply constraints.

title: Rent in advance ban creates access issues for tenants
summary:
Major estate agencies have reported that the ban on rent-in-advance payments under the Renters' Rights Act is preventing vulnerable tenants from accessing rental properties. Executives from LRG and Connells have raised concerns that the prohibition particularly affects overseas students and tenants with poor credit ratings.

title: Government plans £116m property transaction cost savings
summary:
The government has announced plans to reduce costs for businesses in the property transaction chain by £116 million annually through streamlined homebuying and selling processes. The measure forms part of a broader deregulation package worth nearly £800 million per year, with full details scheduled for the Budget on 28 October.

title: Government proposes EV charging rights for renters
summary:
The UK Government has launched a consultation on proposals to grant tenants and leaseholders new rights to request electric vehicle charging point installations at their properties. The measures aim to address structural barriers that officials say prevent renters from installing home charging infrastructure.

The post Government proposes EV charging rights for renters appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: First-time buyer scheme income caps raised ahead of Budget
summary:
The government has increased income thresholds for its Your First Home scheme ahead of Wednesday's Budget announcement. The maximum household income cap has been raised from £90,000 to £110,000 outside London, whilst the London cap has increased from £110,000 to £140,000.

title: Property software firm adds AI tools for admin tasks
summary:
Property software provider Veco has released four artificial intelligence-powered features within its Ask Veco assistant, aimed at automating administrative tasks for estate and letting agents across the UK. The tools address compliance documentation, supplier invoices, repair reporting and applicant matching.

title: Five sport-focused homes listed across England
summary:
Five residential properties with sports facilities or proximity to sporting venues have been listed across England, ranging from £350,000 to £2.995 million. The listings include properties in London, Kent, Birmingham, Devon and Cumbria.

title: Paragon Bank provides £3.3m for Derbyshire trade park
summary:
Paragon Bank's Development Finance division has provided £3.3 million to Litton Properties for a seven-unit trade park at Markham Vale in Derbyshire. The transaction represents Paragon's first completed deal since launching its light industrial lending proposition earlier this year.
